**Delta re-review: ready for the maintainer to merge.**

Checked: the new commits since the last reviewed head are only merges of upstream main plus the PROCESS_VERSION edit; `git show --remerge-diff` of each merge shows no hand hunk except the PROCESS_VERSION line. `.claude/PROCESS_VERSION` is 34 (upstream/main is 33; #1161 holds 34, #1309 holds 35) and the PR body's #681 text names it. Trial merge with current upstream/main is clean and `gh pr view` reports MERGEABLE. The change is skill text only (no xtask, no Rust): the new `rename_operation` and `reorder_operation` rows match `crates/app/src/mcp/order_tools.rs` (tool names, `new_name`/`target`/`place` fields, 1-120 character name, same-setup refusal, one undo step).
The two PRs must merge in PV order: #1161 (34) before #1309 (35).

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
